hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; case "$f" in "$PWD"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.py) uv run ruff format "$f" && uv run ruff check --fix "$f";; *.md) uv run ruff format "$f";; esac > /dev/null 2>&1 || true

input=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(uv lock --check 2>&1 && uv run ruff check -q . 2>&1 && uv run ruff format --check -q . 2>&1 && uv run ty check 2>&1 && uv run pytest -q 2>&1) || printf '%s' "$out" | jq -Rs '{decision:"block",reason:("local checks failed - fix before finishing:\n"+.)}'
